name: build-visionos-apps
description: Build, run, debug, refactor, and ship visionOS 27 (beta) apps with XcodeBuildMCP-first Apple Vision Pro workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, debug, refactor, and ship visionOS 27 apps with XcodeBuildMCP-first workflows
interface.longDescription: Development for Apple Vision Pro on visionOS 27: shared platform skills from visionOSAgents for spatial SwiftUI, RealityKit, ARKit, SharePlay, WidgetKit, immersive media, Shader Graph, USD, USDKit, Chart3D, and coding standards, plus plugin-local XcodeBuildMCP-first workflow skills for build/run/debug, testing, signing, telemetry, SwiftPM, packaging, UI automation, Spatial Preview, command entrypoints, and Run-button fallback bootstrap. UI automation uses XCTest/XCUITest, XcodeBuildMCP, xcodebuild, simctl, app debug hooks, and ScreenCaptureKit; asc is the only optional external CLI documented for distribution automation.
defaultPrompt: Build, run, and debug a visionOS 27 app with XcodeBuildMCP on Apple Vision Pro Simulator.
Choose the right window, volume, or immersive surface and inspect RealityKit, ARKit, and SharePlay behavior.
Prepare packaging and distribution workflows with optional external CLIs only when available.
